adjudication_policy: Adjudicator runs only after both reviewers complete and receives evidence packets plus both reviewer outputs.
adjudicator_access: Adjudicator uses evidence packets plus both reviewer outputs after independent review completes.
disagreement_examples_policy: Disagreement examples are sampled from naturally differing reviewer1 and reviewer2 labels after adjudication.
evidence_collector_access: Evidence collector packets omit ranker name, rank, score, reviewer labels, and adjudication labels.
reviewer1_access: Reviewer 1 uses evidence packets only and does not receive Reviewer 2 output or adjudication output.
reviewer2_access: Reviewer 2 uses evidence packets only and does not receive Reviewer 1 output or adjudication output.
reviewer_independence_policy: Reviewer 1 and Reviewer 2 are separate binddrift-review role artifacts; reviewer role inputs omit ranker name, rank, score, adjudicated labels, and the other reviewer output.
